notes.zh-CN: 浏览器现在与对话关联：每个对话在 GrokX 运行期间保留自己的标签页、当前页面和浏览器开关；切换对话会恢复对应页面，后台对话独立浏览，删除对话会关闭其标签页。网站登录仍使用共享浏览器配置。本次提供 macOS universal 与 Windows x64 / ARM64 安装包。
notes.en: The browser is now associated with each conversation: while GrokX is running, every chat keeps its own tabs, active page and pane toggle. Switching chats restores their pages, background agents browse independently, and deleting a chat closes its tabs. Website sign-ins still use the shared browser profile. This release provides the macOS universal installer plus Windows x64 and ARM64 installers.
